subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should immediate text acknowledgement be a global messages setting, a typed non-terminal plugin/channel lifecycle, or remain channel-specific presence behavior?
rationale: The choice determines public configuration, plugin API ownership, and channel update/deletion semantics; automation cannot safely choose that permanent contract.

options.title: Portable lifecycle with defaults
options.body: Add a typed send-and-continue acknowledgement action, global defaults, and channel or account overrides where capabilities differ.

options.title: Channel-specific presence
options.body: Keep placeholders and processing indicators in individual channel plugins and track parity separately.

options.title: Reaction and typing only
options.body: Decline text acknowledgements and document reactions and typing as the supported early-feedback contract.

recommendation.title: Portable lifecycle with defaults
recommendation.body: Add a typed send-and-continue acknowledgement action, global defaults, and channel or account overrides where capabilities differ.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows the strongest connection to the shared dispatch and acknowledgement lifecycle decision surface.
